title: prettyBytes loses precision for very large values
description: When a value is larger than the biggest unit can show in three significant digits, `prettyBytes` must not round away its integer digits: `prettyBytes(827181 * 1e26)` should print `82718100 YB`. The same applies with the `binary` and `bits` options and with locales. Keep at least three significant digits as today, but never fewer digits than the integer part of the number has.
acceptance_criteria: the integer part of a value is never rounded away, with or without the `binary` option
values that fit in three significant digits format exactly as before
notes: SWE-bench-style. base_ref is the upstream fix's parent; hidden/test.js is the upstream test file at fix_commit. The scratch repo must hold base_ref's history only (bench/factory/README.md, 'Scratch repositories').
